text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! With this win in the
semi-finals,
you've earned yourself a
spot in the finals!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in your trainee's
passionate
race, I completely forgot
about my work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course, this incredible result is thanks
to your
firm bond with your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any words for her going
into the
final race?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Simply amazing! What strength of
feeling
contained in such simple words!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! You've got what it takes!
You'd do
anything for victory! Even
spending all your
savings on a reward for
your trainee!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What stirring determination! I'm looking
forward
to seeing you in the finals!
